title: SugarCraft — SugarClipboard
description: SugarClipboard: clipboard access for SugarCraft — a skeleton for now; the clipboard classes and the OSC 52 backend arrive in a later step. Original work; first-party.
ogDescription: Clipboard access for SugarCraft terminal programs, with an OSC 52 backend that works over SSH and inside multiplexers.
tagline: Clipboard access — skeleton, no API yet
